sources.snippet: MedGemma is a collection of Gemma 3 variants trained for performance on medical text and image comprehension to accelerate the building of healthcare-based AI applications. MedGemma comes in a 4B multimodal version, a 27B text-only version, and a 27B multimodal version, with multimodal versions utilizing a SigLIP image encoder trained on de-identified medical data. sources.title: MedGemma 1.5 4B: Multimodal Medical AI Model - emergentmind.com
sources.snippet: MedGemma 1.5 4B is an open-weight, 4-billion-parameter multimodal medical foundation model built upon the Gemma 3 architecture. It serves as a compact yet extensible platform for a wide range of medical AI tasks, including 3D radiology, pathology imaging, clinical report understanding, anatomical localization, and longitudinal imaging analysis.
